candidates.spoken: Eastern Air Lines Flight 212 crashed short of the runway at Charlotte.
Nothing was wrong with the aircraft.
Investigators blamed a lack of attention.
A DC-9 crashed in fog several miles short of the Charlotte runway.
On approach, the crew talked about politics and cars.
The jet descended far below the safe height.
It took only a crew distracted by idle conversation during approach.
It led to the sterile cockpit rule.
It started with fog on approach. It ended with crash short of runway.

script.spoken: Nothing broke on the aircraft. It broke apart and burned, and seventy two of eighty two aboard were killed. Nothing was wrong with the aircraft. On approach, the crew talked about politics and cars. Nobody watched the altitude closely. The jet descended far below the safe height. Investigators blamed a lack of attention. It led to the sterile cockpit rule.
